about_the_game:
Jump into a wild, cartoon-style battle royale where every match is a chance to show off your skills and creativity! Fight to be the last survivor on a colorful island full of surprises — or switch things up with fun rotating game modes like Floor is Lava, Capture the Flag, and more.

The game evolves constantly with regular updates, new seasons, fresh content, and game-changing features. Unlock exclusive cosmetics and rewards through the Battle Pass, or customize your experience with optional in-game purchases.

Compete with friends, level up, and discover endless ways to play in an ever-growing multiplayer universe inspired by the classic OG battle royale vibe.

🛈 A Chadi El-sayed World account is required to play online.
🛈 Includes optional microtransactions.

Are you ready to drop in and dominate the island?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bits
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bits
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 / AMD Ryzen 7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: A cartoon battle royale! Fight to be the last player standing on a vibrant island full of surprises. Enjoy extra modes like Floor is Lava, Capture the Flag and more. Build, battle and outplay opponents in fast-paced multiplayer fun!
